notes.key_messages:
• Candidates did least well with the questions involving international exchange rates and need to
understand their analysis in numerical and diagram form.
notes.general_comments:
The topics that candidates found easiest were scarcity, the production possibility curve, elasticity of supply,
market equilibrium, consumer surplus, ability to pay and the terms of trade. Particular difficulties arose with
price elasticity of demand and international exchange rates. The latter involved both diagram and numerical
presentations.
Generally there was no significant difference in the ability to answer questions in verbal, numerical or
diagram form.
